originalRequest:
Implement m3a-007 in the real Tokage repository. SessionHistoryView unconditionally replaces attempts/chatLogs arrays after every successful SQLite poll even when every row is unchanged, rebuilding the tree and committing needless React updates. Reuse existing state arrays for equal ordered row snapshots while still processing successful-read loading/error recovery and real changes. Keep this optimization local to the view plus a small pure helper if useful; do not change pollHistory, polling cadence/visibility/backoff, stores, IPC, DB/auth/model execution or Git identity. Add real rendered SessionHistoryView regressions using real pollHistory and React Profiler (or equivalent actual commit measurement), plus comparator tests if adding a helper. Preserve every existing regression. Do not edit outside write_scope even transiently, or edit .tokage/docs/runner/packages/build configuration. Host handles task commits with default author/committer and built-in Tokage co-author; do not commit yourself or change Git config. Use ignored src-tauri/target/m3a-tmp as TMPDIR before all tests/build and seeded workspace npm cache for offline npm ci. Run all commands. Required TaskReport headings; deviations None if none. Independent exact-head review and real desktop merge acceptance remain pending.

Preregistered acceptance:
After mount and initial settling, at least 100 successive actual poll cycles returning freshly allocated but equal attempt/log rows produce zero additional SessionHistoryView React commits. Use actual rendered React with real pollHistory and Profiler, not a helper-only callback counter; assert IPC reads still occur so the test cannot pass by stopping polling. Keep existing observer/scroll behavior.
Ordered snapshot equality must account for every own row field and key presence, not just IDs/text/status or a fragile whitelist. Row count, order, metadata/tool JSON, timestamps, provider/model/provenance/token/status changes and added optional/future fields must invalidate equality. Do not mutate input rows/arrays, depend on object key insertion order, or serialize full snapshots with JSON.stringify each poll. Current row values are scalar IPC fields.
Successful equal snapshots after an attempt-list or transcript read error must clear the appropriate error/loading state. Optimizing row state must not skip read-success acknowledgement. Initial empty/loading states, selected-attempt/session switches and late old-read cleanup remain correct.
Real changes still render immediately: test attempt status/context updates, log content and metadata-only tool output changes, row reorder/add/remove, live in-memory transcript updates, and selection retention for an existing attempt. Scrolled-up reading intent and return-to-latest remain intact across unchanged polling and real growth.
All existing frontend regressions remain unchanged and pass; full frontend tests, typecheck, i18n and production build pass without dependencies/build, poller/store/IPC, DB/auth/model or Git config/identity changes. Independent review at the exact accepted head precedes real desktop UI merge. Verify CODEX_CLI/gpt-6-luna durable DONE; archive failures and assistance. Performance claims limited to measured commit counts.
Environment repaired and independently verified: each worktree receives an independent writable npm cache at src-tauri/target/m3a-npm-cache. Use npm --cache ./src-tauri/target/m3a-npm-cache for installs, with --offline --ignore-scripts; happy-dom@21.0.3 and this project dependencies are seeded. For test commands, create src-tauri/target/m3a-tmp and set TMPDIR="$PWD/src-tauri/target/m3a-tmp". These paths are already ignored. Do not write HOME or relax sandbox policy. Actually render SessionHistoryView in a DOM regression; do not replace this with EventTarget-only tests or omit tests because the previous shared cache failed.

仓库里未找到 `.tokage/context.md`（读取命令在第一步即失败）；我会继续核对工作树和限定范围内文件，并遵守任务简报中更具体的“不提交”要求。

视图目前每次成功回调都会传入新数组；已加入按行顺序、全部自有键和值比较的纯函数，并在成功回调中仍单独执行 loading/error 恢复与选中项保留逻辑。接下来补真实 DOM 测试，直接使用 `pollHistory` 并用 Profiler 统计提交。

快照回归现在在真实 `pollHistory` 下通过：基线 settle 后连续 100 个周期中，Profiler 提交数不变，attempt 与 log IPC 读取都持续增加。完整验收链已完成；我最后核对变更范围与工作树状态。

Added ordered snapshot equality that checks every own key and scalar value without relying on key insertion order or serializing rows. `SessionHistoryView` now reuses equal attempt and log arrays while still acknowledging successful reads and clearing loading/error state.

Added comparator tests and a rendered DOM regression using real `pollHistory` and React Profiler. After settling, 100 successive equal poll cycles produced zero additional commits, while both IPC read counts continued to increase.

### Deviations from contracts

None

### Hints for downstream

The required acceptance checks passed. Independent exact-head review and real desktop merge acceptance remain pending. No commit was created, as instructed. `.tokage/context.md` was absent from the worktree.

### Self-check against acceptance criteria

`npm ci --ignore-scripts --offline --no-audit --no-fund`, typecheck, all frontend tests (49 files, 351 tests), i18n check, and production build passed. Changes are limited to the requested write scope.
